trends.name: Hormuz Strait Crisis & Oil Supply
trends.summary: Iran-US escalation threatens Strait of Hormuz shipping with Trump signaling military strikes on Iranian infrastructure including bridges and power plants. Oil prices hit $112/barrel with diesel near record $5.52/gal; existing bypass pipelines cover only 40-45% of 21M bpd flow, suggesting 10-20+ year infrastructure buildout costing $40B+. Market closed 63 hours with heightened geopolitical risk.

trends.name: March Jobs Report & Rate Cut Pause
trends.summary: Strong 178,000 March payroll beat contradicts expectations of slowdown; unemployment steady at 4.3% but wage growth at lowest since May 2021 (3.5% YoY) signals moderating labor market. Market repricing kills Fed rate cut narrative—stock futures and bonds sold off, Treasury yields climbed, suggesting 'higher for longer' rates persist despite soft wages.

trends.name: Energy Cost Inflation Across Economy
trends.summary: Diesel prices at record highs, airline checked bag fees rising $10, private aviation costs up 20%, and fuel surcharges cascading through consumer discretionary. Fed's Williams confirms higher energy prices hitting both inflation and disposable incomes; war impact showing in gas prices but not yet in employment data—lag risk for stagflation.

trends.name: Healthcare System Breakdown & Insurer Conflict
trends.summary: Dual crisis: doctors increasingly frustrated with insurer denials while hospitals refuse Medicare Advantage for cancer patients, creating care access gaps. Represents systemic rejection of current insurance model—regulatory/political pressure building for reform, impacting UNH, CI, HUM valuations and creating sector rotation risk.

trends.name: Tech Supply Chain Fragility Under Geopolitical Stress
trends.summary: Tech sector masking supply chain vulnerabilities amid Iran-US escalation and Trump tariff uncertainty. Semiconductor and component sourcing faces dual pressure from Middle East instability and trade policy chaos—valuations not reflecting hidden capex/sourcing risks, particularly for companies with Taiwan/Middle East exposure.

trends.name: Trump Tariff & Trade Policy Uncertainty
trends.summary: Lingering tariff effects one year later compounding current uncertainty; 100% pharma tariffs signaled but impact rated limited by analysts. Trump's Iran aggression rhetoric suggests broader trade/geopolitical interventionism. Markets struggling to price policy volatility—creates both hedging needs and selective value opportunities in tariff-resistant sectors.

trends.name: Oil Price Shock & Recessionary Tail Risk
trends.summary: $112 oil and record diesel pushing inflation higher while wage growth slows—classic stagflation setup. Analysts identifying 'dirt cheap' high-yield plays (14%+ yields) as oil panic creates dislocations. Risk: sustained $110+ oil + geopolitical uncertainty could trigger demand destruction and recession within 6-12 months.

trends.name: Meta & Google Legal Shield Under Attack
trends.summary: Court cases bypassing 30-year-old Section 230 legal protections for Big Tech, creating liability and regulatory risk. Represents existential challenge to platform economics—potential for damages, compliance costs, content moderation expenses to accelerate. Market hasn't fully priced regulatory/litigation tail risk for GOOG, META.

trends.name: Private Credit Market Repricing & Systemic Risk Watch
trends.summary: Fed's Williams acknowledges monitoring private credit closely following recent market repricing, though doesn't see current systemic risk. 'Clear reasons' cited for repricing amid uncertainty. Signals Fed concern about non-bank lending contagion—watch for margin calls, fund liquidations if energy shocks persist.

trends.name: Consumer Discretionary Stress & Margin Compression
trends.summary: Starbucks turnaround efforts failing to support stock; Easter inflation (candy, decorations) forcing consumer budget cuts; $4+ gas prices feel worse psychologically than 2021 despite inflation normalization. Signals discretionary spending weakness ahead—impacts restaurants, travel, retail earnings guidance for Q2+.

trends.name: SpaceX IPO & Space Industry Valuation Surge
trends.summary: SpaceX IPO signaling mega-cap private company valuations moving public—Elon Musk's broader portfolio (Tesla, X, Starlink) under scrutiny. Represents private market exuberance potentially mispricing space/satellite sector; watch for IPO window opening for other unicorns if SpaceX prices richly.

trends.name: Fed's 'Low Hire, Low Fire' Economy & Wage Stagnation
trends.summary: Fed's Williams describes economy as stable but with minimal hiring/firing—contradicts March beat but aligns with low wage growth (3.5% YoY). Labor market softening beneath headline jobs number suggests Fed can avoid cuts while inflation persists. Wage stagnation + energy costs = real income decline for consumers, darkening outlook.
